title: Deconstructing Intraocular Pressure: A Non-Invasive Multi-Stage Probabilistic Inverse Framework
abstract: arXiv:2509.14167v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose the mechanistically hierarchical inverse problem (MHIP) paradigm for biological transport systems, where a macroscopic observation emerges from the multiplicative entanglement of intrinsic micro-scale physics and latent macro-scale geometry. Without in vivo ground truth, solving MHIPs from clinical data is severely underdetermined. Standard statistical sampling degenerates along non-identifiable manifolds, while monolithic machine learning baselines collapse to an uninterpretable conditional mean. We propose a two-stage physics-guided decomposition that turns a globally non-identifiable inverse mapping into conditionally identifiable sub-problems. The first stage is a constrained inverse surrogate that isolates the intrinsic parameter under a fixed reference geometry. The second stage performs empirical structural calibration against population-level clinical data. We also introduce Physics-Calibrated Data Scaling (PCDS),

translated_title: 解构眼压：一种无创的多阶段概率逆问题框架
translated_abstract: 我们提出了面向生物输运系统的机制分层逆问题（MHIP）范式，其中宏观观测量源于微观尺度内在物理与潜在宏观尺度几何之间的乘性纠缠。在缺乏体内真值的情况下，从临床数据求解MHIP是严重欠定的：标准统计采样会沿不可辨识流形退化，而整体式机器学习基线则会坍缩为不可解释的条件均值。我们提出一种两阶段的物理引导分解方法，将全局不可辨识的逆映射转化为条件可辨识的子问题。第一阶段是一个受约束的逆代理模型，在固定参考几何下分离出内在参数；第二阶段则基于人群水平的临床数据进行经验结构校准。我们还引入了物理校准数据缩放（PCDS），
tldr: 该论文提出一种机制分层的两阶段物理引导逆问题框架（MHIP），将全局不可辨识的眼压逆问题分解为条件可辨识的子问题，并结合物理校准数据缩放（PCDS），从而在缺乏体内真值的条件下实现从临床数据中对眼压相关内在参数的无创概率估计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Mechanistically Hierarchical Inverse Problem (MHIP) framework that decomposes the globally non-identifiable intraocular pressure inverse problem into conditionally identifiable two-stage physics-guided sub-problems with Physics-Calibrated Data Scaling (PCDS), enabling non-invasive probabilistic estimation of intrinsic parameters from clinical data without in vivo ground truth.
